title: Diagnose and repair a rejected-promise cache incident
forbidden_actions: Edit the committed visible test, incident log, task definitions, harness files, or generated evidence
Install dependencies or use the network
Add sleeps, arbitrary retry loops, or a second cache
Commit, push, or start an external service

acceptance_checks.description: The committed incident tests and assistant-authored regression tests pass.
Private failure-eviction, overlapping-replacement, cache-contract, isolation, API, and test-quality checks pass.
The completed incident note explains impact, evidence, misleading signals, the narrow fix, regression coverage, and remaining risk.
Only the four allowed implementation, test, and incident-report files change.
